paite: Aw TOUPA, na kiang a ka phun in leng, nang zaw na dik nilouh a; himahleh ka vuina thu pen ka gen ding hi. Bangchi in ahia mithulimloute lam alamzan zel uh? Bangchi in ahia khemhat peuhmah nuamsa a a-om nak uh?
heading: Jeremiah In TOUPA Adong
english: You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to plead a case with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously?

paite: Amau na phut a, ahi, zung akaita ua, akhang ua, ahi, gah asuahta uhi; amuk un hon naih ua, asunggil un hon gamlat uhi.
english: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

paite: Aw TOUPA kei bel na hon thei a, na hon mu a, nang lam ah ka lungtang na entel sek a, amaute goh ding belam bang mai in kaikhia inla, agohna ni ding uh sep in.
english: But you, Yahweh, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

paite: Gam in bang tan ahia asuun ding a, anteh louhingte avuai ding uh? Ateng mite thulim louh ziak in gamsate amang khin ua, vasate leng, "I hun nanung uh amu kei ding uh," achih ziak un.
english: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”

paite: "Khe a pai mite toh na kitaiteh a, nang ahon bahsak khit uleh bangchi in sakolte na kitaitehpih thei dia? Muanna gam ah bittak in om lechin leng, Jordan gammang ah bangchi in na hih dia?
heading: Pathian Dawnna
english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

paite: Na unaute, na pa inkuante ngei in, amau nang ahon khemta ngal ua; amau nang hon delh in ngaihtak in ahon sam ua, thuhoihtak gen mah le uh taksang himhim ke'n."
english: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried aloud after you! Don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

paite: "Ka inn-le-lou paisan in ka gouluah ding ka paimangta; ka hinna in a-it mahmah nu, amelma kiang ah ka peta hi.
heading: Amite Ziak A TOUPA Lungkhamna
english: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

paite: Ka gouluah ding gamnuai humpinelkai bang ahong hita, ka siatna ding in a-aw asuah a, huaiziak in ka mudah ahi.
english: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.

paite: Ka gouluah ding kei a ding in sasial ne vasa gial ahi hia? Sasial ne vasate'n akimvel in asual ua hia? Gamsa teng va kaikhawm unla, nek bei ding in hon pi un.
english: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour.

paite: "Belamchingmi tampi in ka grephuan ahihsia ua, ka tan asikden ua, ka tantuan nuam mahmah mai gamdai gam segawp asuaksakta uh.
english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

paite: Gamsia in abawlta ua, asegawp a, ka kiang ah avui hi, agam pumpi asegawp a, himahleh kuamah in adonsak kei uh.
english: They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.

paite: Gamdai a tang giau tengteng ah, hihse mite ahong tungta ua, gam tawp khat lam a kipan leh khat lam pha in TOUPA namsau in lah anebeita a, muanna nei himhim a-omta kei uh.
english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Yahweh devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.

paite: Buhchi atuh ua, ling ala ua, akihihgimgawp ua, punna lah a-om tuan kei, TOUPA heh mahmah ziak in gah na suahte uh na zumpih ding uh."
english: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of Yahweh’s fierce anger.”

paite: Ka mi Israel kiang a gouluah ding a ka piak khoihsemi, ka inveng giloute tengteng tungtang ah TOUPA'N hichibang in achi: "Ngai un, agam ua kipan ka botkhe ding a, alak ua kipan Judah inkote ka phawikhe ding.
heading: Israel Invengte Kiang A TOUPA Thuchiam
english: Yahweh says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka bohkhiak nung in amau ka hehpih nawn ding a, michih gouluah ding leh michih ama gam mah ah ka hon pi ding.
english: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Baal kiang a ka mite kichiam a asinsak mah bang un, ka min a, 'TOUPA ahin a ahin sung', chi a kichiam a akisin ua, ka mite omdan ngenteltak a asin uleh ka mite lak ah ka dingkhesak ding.
english: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As Yahweh lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.

paite: Himahleh angaihkhiak kei ualeh huai nam aboh in ka botkhe ding a, ka hihse ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says Yahweh.
